statement.zh: Layard 第二次大英博物馆尼尼微与巴比伦考察见其 1853 年纪事《尼尼微与巴比伦废墟中的发现》（历史性一手叙述；现代标准不同）。
statement.en: Layard’s second British Museum expedition to Nineveh and Babylon is documented in his 1853 narrative Discoveries in the Ruins of Nineveh and Babylon (historical primary narrative; modern standards differ).
